**Title: Chapter 29 Motor Control PWM (MCPWM)**

**Section Title: Reset**

- **Table**: 
  - The table lists various interrupt clear registers with their corresponding bit positions and descriptions.
  
  | Bit Position Range | Description |
  |--------------------|-------------|
  | 31 to 0            | Various interrupt flags for different PWM channels, operators, events, faults, etc. |

**Descriptions of Interrupt Clear Registers:**
- **INT_CAP2_INT_CLR**: Set this bit to clear interrupt triggered by capture on channel 2.
- **INT_CAP1_INT_CLR**: Set this bit to clear interrupt triggered by capture on channel 1.
- **INT_CAPO0_INT_CLR**: Set this bit to clear interrupt triggered by capture on channel 0.
- **INT_FH2cacl_INT_CLR**: Set this bit to clear interrupt triggered by a one-shot mode action on PWM2 (WO).
